title: 第23章 爱卿挑个合心意的第24章 上门求亲
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
随后又来一个人，说道：“昔丞相您这么美，就跟仙女下凡一样，我家儿长得也很英俊，昔丞相要不要处一处……”
昔小苑尴尬的笑了，说道：“呵呵呵……那…那个就不必了吧~”
另一个又说道：“我家长子不仅英俊还是个十八般武艺、样样精通呐，昔丞相…您……”
随后又有一个打断了的说道：“您别听他说，我家儿都比他家长子还要不错，而且还会做菜，样样色香味俱全……”
“他家儿会做菜，我家儿也会……”
他们推销着自家儿子，昔小苑抹了一把汗，她还没有这打算呢，怎么各个都这么着急的把自家儿子介绍给她……
真是让她慌得可以。
昔小苑小步伐压低存在感默默的走开，但是又被一个人给拉了回来，满脸笑容的说道：“昔丞相呀，我儿很快就过来了，一会我带给昔丞相瞧瞧呀……”
昔小苑一脸故作镇定的说道：“那…”
昔小苑还没说完，又被打断了，另一个人说道：“我家儿也很快过来了，一定会让昔丞相满意的，他家儿还不够咱家儿长得俊呢，而且我家儿文采极好……”
昔小苑一脸的尴尬，很是无奈的站在那里听他们介绍着自家儿子，而且他们还说的起劲了。
随即大殿外一声高昂的声音传来：“皇上驾到，皇后娘娘驾到。”
哦豁，昔小苑感觉自己有救了，各位看见皇上和皇后要进来了，而后各个集体坐回各自的位置上等候。
昔小苑猛的松了一口气，而后安安静静的坐了下来，随即喝了一口酒定了定惊……
昔小苑内心自我自恋着，这些人都怎么了，是不是因为她太美了迫不及待想把自家儿子送过来~那她以后是不是美男如云了？
但是这里没有一女多男的说法，而且她也不可能同意的呀，这得显的她多么花心风流呀……
穆贺和皇后走进大殿，神态自若的走着，随即集体的都人站了起来，双手抱拳恭敬的说道：“恭候皇上，恭候皇后娘娘……”
穆贺坐上他的皇座，他拿起桌上的小酒杯，示意各位都可以坐下了，各位随后接收到穆贺的意思便都坐了下来，而后他们拿起桌上的酒杯……
穆贺微笑的说道：“这宴席是为了昔丞相举行的，恭喜昔丞相成功剿匪回来。”
穆贺拿着手里的酒杯示意了一下昔小苑，昔小苑看见穆贺瞧着她，随即微微笑的回敬…

穆贺说完便一口就把酒一饮而尽了，下面的人随即也跟着一饮而尽。
穆贺很是大度的继而说道：“开宴。”
很快穿着好看年轻的奴婢们走了进来，各个手里端着菜，很快每个人的桌上便都上满了菜。
昔小苑看着桌上的菜，哟嚯…竟然有她喜欢的甜酸排骨，呀…口水都要流出来了。
“大家吃好喝好，不要跟朕客气。”穆贺拿起一杯酒随后敬了大家一杯的说道。
每个人也集体敬了穆贺一杯，说道：“谢皇上~”
很快中央便有舞姬上来翩翩起舞，昔小苑看终于能开动了，她立马夹起那甜酸排骨吃了起来…
昔小苑很开心的吃着，好好吃哦～
昔小苑一边吃着一边看着那些舞姬跳舞，而且有年轻男子对昔小苑笑笑，很是礼貌的示意的喝了一口酒，昔小苑也示意性的喝了一口酒。
而后继续高高兴兴的吃着她那喜欢的甜酸排骨。
她吃着吃着觉得有个眼神盯着她，昔小苑看了过去，发现穆贺一脸的笑意，而后还拿起酒杯，昔小苑跟着穆贺示意性的喝了口。
昔小苑随后撇过脑袋，这丫的干嘛又对她笑，这让她很慌，不会又有什么不好的是吧，昔小苑左眼突然跳了起来……
左眼都跳了，应该没好事。不对吧…应该不至于吧，所以应该是她太敏感了，皇上说不定只是礼貌的对她笑一笑而已。
应该不会又坑她的…希望如此。
大家吃吃喝喝，看舞姬那婀娜多姿的舞姿在起舞着。昔小苑有些贪杯多喝了些，那酒还挺好喝…
昔小苑拖着下巴，眯了眯眼睛听着那奏乐，灵动又好听。
正当昔小苑这么享受的时候，穆贺突然发话了，说道：“爱卿？”
昔小苑还在闭着眼睛陶醉着，旁边的官员看昔小苑还没反应过来，轻轻的推了她一下，说道：“皇上叫您呢…”
昔小苑反应过来便站了起来，而后恭敬的对皇上说道：“回皇上，臣在。”
穆贺微微一笑的说道：“别这么拘谨，坐下吧。”

昔小苑回道：“是。”而后坐了下去，刚刚起的有点猛，她都差点没反应过来。
穆贺一脸笑意的对昔小苑说道：“爱卿呐~你帮朕做了件好事，朕打算奖赏你。”
昔小苑微微一笑的说道：“不敢不敢。”
穆贺继而说道：“朕看你这么久都是一个人，朕打算给你定门亲事。”
content_en:
Then another person came and said: "Prime Minister Xi, you are so beautiful, just like a fairy descending to earth. My son is also very handsome. Prime Minister Xi, do you want to be in the same place..."
Xi Xiaoyuan smiled awkwardly and said, "Hehehe... then... that's not necessary~"
Another said: "My eldest son is not only handsome, he is also proficient in all kinds of martial arts. Former Prime Minister...you..."
Then another person interrupted and said: "Don't listen to him, my children are better than his eldest son, and they can also cook, and everything is delicious and delicious..."
"His family knows how to cook, and my family can also..."
They were promoting their sons. Xi Xiaoyuan wiped her sweat. She had no plans to do so yet. Why were everyone so anxious to introduce their sons to her...
It really made her panic.
Xi Xiaoyuan walked away silently, keeping her presence low, but was pulled back by someone again. She said with a smile on her face: "Prime Minister Xi, my son will be here soon. I will show it to Prime Minister Xi later..."
Xi Xiaoyuan said calmly: "Then..."
Before Xi Xiaoyuan finished speaking, he was interrupted again. Another person said: "My son will come here soon. He will definitely satisfy Prime Minister Xi. His son is not as handsome as ours, and my son is very talented in literature..."
Xi Xiaoyuan looked embarrassed and stood there helplessly listening to them introduce her son, and they talked enthusiastically.
Then a high-pitched voice came from outside the main hall: "The Emperor has arrived, the Queen has arrived."
Oh, Xi Xiaoyuan felt that she was saved. Everyone saw that the emperor and queen were coming in, and then everyone sat back in their respective seats and waited.
Xi Xiaoyuan breathed a sigh of relief, then sat down quietly, and then took a sip of wine to calm down...
Xi Xiaoyuan was narcissistic in her heart. What happened to these people? Is it because she is so beautiful that she can’t wait to send her son over? Then will she be as beautiful as a cloud in the future?
But there is no such thing as one woman with multiple men, and she couldn't agree to it. This would show how flirtatious she is...
Mu He and the Queen walked into the hall and walked calmly. Then everyone stood up, clasped their hands and said respectfully: "Your Majesty, Your Majesty, Your Majesty..."
Mu He sat on his throne. He picked up the small wine glass on the table and signaled that everyone could sit down. After receiving Mu He's intention, everyone sat down, and then they picked up the wine glasses on the table...
Mu He said with a smile: "This banquet is held for Prime Minister Xi. Congratulations to Prime Minister Xi for successfully suppressing the bandits."
Mu He gestured to Xi Xiaoyuan with the wine glass in his hand. Xi Xiaoyuan saw Mu He looking at her, and then smiled back...
After Mu He finished speaking, he drank the wine in one gulp, and the people below also drank it in one gulp.
Mu He said very generously: "Have a banquet."
Soon the young slaves in nice clothes came in, each carrying dishes in their hands, and soon everyone's table was filled with dishes.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the dishes on the table, wow... there was her favorite sweet and sour pork ribs, ah... her mouth was watering.
"Eat and drink well, everyone, don't be polite to me." Mu He picked up a glass of wine and toasted everyone.
Everyone also toasted to Mu He collectively and said, "Thank you, Your Majesty~"
Soon a dancer came up to dance in the middle. Seeing that Xi Xiaoyuan could finally start moving, she immediately picked up the sweet and sour pork ribs and started eating...
Xi Xiaoyuan ate it happily, it was delicious~
Xi Xiaoyuan watched the dancers dancing while eating, and a young man smiled at Xi Xiaoyuan and politely took a sip of wine, and Xi Xiaoyuan also took a sip of wine as a sign.
Then she continued to happily eat her favorite sweet and sour pork ribs.
As she ate, she felt a look staring at her. Xi Xiaoyuan looked at itWhen I went there, I found Mu He with a smile on his face, and then picked up the wine glass. Xi Xiaoyuan followed Mu He and took a sip as a sign.
Xi Xiaoyuan then turned his head away, why was this guy smiling at her again? This made her panic, there couldn't be anything bad, right? Xi Xiaoyuan's left eye suddenly jumped...
My left eye is twitching, so it's probably not good. No...it shouldn't be the case, so she must be too sensitive. The emperor might just smile at her politely.
He shouldn't trick her again... I hope so.
Everyone was eating, drinking, and watching the graceful dancers dancing. Xi Xiaoyuan was a little greedy and drank too much. The wine was quite delicious...
Xi Xiaoyuan dragged her chin and squinted her eyes to listen to the music, which was lively and beautiful.
Just when Xi Xiaoyuan was enjoying so much, Mu He suddenly spoke and said, "Ai Qing?"
Xi Xiaoyuan was still intoxicated with her eyes closed. Seeing that Xi Xiaoyuan had not yet reacted, the official next to her gently pushed her and said, "The Emperor is calling you..."
Xi Xiaoyuan reacted and stood up, then respectfully said to the emperor: "Go back to the emperor, I am here."
Mu He smiled slightly and said, "Don't be so formal. Sit down."
Xi Xiaoyuan replied: "Yes." Then she sat down. She had gotten up so violently that she almost didn't react.
Mu He said to Xi Xiaoyuan with a smile on his face: "Ai Qing, you have done a good deed for me, and I plan to reward you."
Xi Xiaoyuan said with a slight smile: "Don't dare."
Mu He then said: "I see that you have been alone for so long, so I plan to arrange a marriage for you."
